metadata_binding: migrations/027_event_provenance.sql stamps revision and provenance within each INSERT transaction; immutable afterward, apart from the separately attributed decision-record link. Initial state revision zero is a defined stored version, never a missing-value substitute.
correlation: Authenticated core mutations use journal_context only inside their savepoint, clear it before commit and disclose their logical ID only to that same stable identity. Task invocation IDs stay in their task namespace. Operation-ledger IDs are already principal owned. Shared-room recipients do not acquire another actor's operation ID.
ordering: Only opaque installation journal cursors order events. Revisions are scoped to the resource named by the fact; gaps are not private-event counts. Session state revision and topology revision are separate.

integration_boundaries: Physical multi-party graphs and stream sources are G6-038. Provider-normalized speech/action/vCon integration remains G6-043/G6-044/G6-046; no provider behavior is inferred by this metadata layer.
canonical_read_boundary: Explicit per-physical canonical subscription handlers reuse the retained journal/snapshot engine. Exact query proofs fence current selected source owners through bounded local submission; idle readers retain no guard. Source growth refuses the page and retries its unchanged cursor under a fresh proof within the original wait/lease. Fixed physical incarnation, credential/key, actor epoch and scope ceiling prevent refresh/readmission revival. Schema34; no new journal insertion sites or migration. Production canonical installation remains open.
canonical_receipt_projection: Canonical message.read calls the existing original-recipient receipt mutation; no new journal insertion site or SQL migration. Current opt-in, recipient epoch, scope, source audience and provenance filter before projection. Eligible typed receipt hints precede their cursor-bearing facts; 63-fact canonical pages remain within 128 envelopes. Both typed receipt kinds are live facts and cannot use terminal snapshot grace. Client read_at is diagnostic; shared evidence uses server observation time. Production native canonical installation remains open.

session_started_writer.versions: Original sessions.state_revision after Active phase commit; separate immutable SessionStarted snapshot.
session_started_writer.provenance: connect-session-lifecycle with original Session ID, no caller operation or Connection envelope scope. One row per captured present Participant epoch, atomically with the first public verified native flow and phase; actual deliveries independently reauthorize.

session_participant_writer.versions: Explicit Session state_revision increment without changing topology_revision. Immutable original joined/left fact and captured subject/recipient membership epochs commit with readiness or departure.
session_participant_writer.provenance: connect-session-lifecycle, correlated to the immutable fact. Authenticated mutation context binds operation correlation only to its owner before the journal fact is frozen. Unsolicited typed hints carry no operation scope; every emitted/catch-up envelope gets a fresh ID.
